summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (placed after print, delegates to print with emoji/markup off, no_wrap on, overflow ignore, crop off; highlight defaults to True). Added RenderHook import and test_out plus related test_out_* tests in tests/test_console.py. Added a "Low level output" section to docs/source/console.rst after logging and an "Added Console.out" bullet under Unreleased in CHANGELOG.md. Tests were not run, per instructions; nothing committed. The test that asserts the exact bold escape bytes mirrors the existing print style test and was not separately traced.
